name: Michael Carter
message: We handed over a fairly messy brief and still got back something clean. Product setup is easy for our team and the store loads fast even with a few hundred SKUs. Monk Cables has been running without a single issue since launch.

name: Bilal Ahmed
message: Our old store used to break every time we added a new variant. This one hasn't given us any trouble in three months. The admin panel is simple enough that my team picked it up in a day.

name: Sarah Johnson
message: Delivered on time and the code was actually documented, which is rare in our experience. We asked for a few changes after launch and they were handled without any back and forth.

name: Ayesha Siddiqui
message: Most of our orders come from phones, and the mobile checkout finally feels right. Drop-off went down noticeably in the first month after we switched over.

name: Usman Tariq
message: One milestone ran about a week late, but the quality made up for it. The backend is properly structured, nothing hacked together, and our own developers had no trouble taking it forward.

name: Emily Davis
message: Good communication throughout. Weekly updates, no surprises, and whatever was promised on the first call actually shipped.
